title: TF2 textures
description: The new wind charge and mace seems familiar
body: The Minecraft snapshots introduced the wind charge and the new mace, however people think that they look kind of familliar, including a [develeoper of the game](https://twitter.com/kingbdogz/status/1755266888878158164) so this resource pack remodels and retextures the wind charge and the mace to look like the rocket jumper and market gardener from TF2 (it also renames them for us english)
